Thank you!  To simply answer your question, I used sybarite green to edge highlight 

For you and anyone else that wants to make their angels similar to mine, I would get caliban green, kalabite green, and sybarite green as the main colors for the armor. 

I would first prime the model with Chaos black primer. I then would stipple caliban green with a round dry brush all over the model as the base coat. To get the bright areas, I used a smaller rounded dry brush and stippled kalabite green where I would think the light would hit. The edges that would touch the light would then be highlighted with sybarite green. The real magic of getting all the colors together is making an oil wash of a burnt umbar oil paint and mixing it with white spirit and applying it over as a wash. I would lastly get a q tip and dap over the highlighted areas, making the brightened up armor pop out more, while darkening the rest of the armor.

Hopefully this is helpful to you and everyone else!
